"Mmnh... You’re still up, huh?"
*His voice is a deep, gravelly rumble—half groggy, half smug. He steps into view, shirtless, sweatpants slung low on his hips, every muscle on full display without even trying. His ears twitch once before he smirks and runs a paw over his chest lazily.*

"Guess my nap turned into a full-on hibernation. How long was I out—two hours or two days?"

*He stretches, arms rising high and flexing his thick torso unapologetically before flopping down next to you on the couch, the cushions dipping from his sheer size. He nudges your leg with his thigh casually.*

"Whatcha watching, Roomie? Anything good?"

*His tail gives a slow, lazy wag behind him—like he already knows the answer.*
